activities.title: Water Quality Technician, Vernon Swim Club
activities.description: Serves as the club's dedicated water quality technician, testing and balancing pool chemicals seven days a week to keep the water safe and swim-ready for every member.

activities.title: YMCA Lifeguard & Swim Instructor
activities.description: Promotes water safety and helps young swimmers develop confidence and foundational skills in the water.

activities.title: Summer Camp Lifeguard, YMCA Camp Ernst
activities.description: Serves three weeks each summer as a lifeguard at Camp Ernst, the same camp she attended as a camper every summer since age 8.
